query:
SELECT s.id AS "id!"
             FROM samples s
            WHERE s.estado = 'activo'
              AND s.publicado_at > NOW() - $1::text::interval
              AND s.creador_id <> ALL($2::int[])
            ORDER BY (s.total_likes * 2 + s.total_reproducciones + s.total_descargas * 3) DESC
            LIMIT $3
